title: Turkey Spinach Scramble with Sweet Potato Hash
description: Golden sweet potato and onion hash with ground turkey, spinach and scrambled egg in one skillet. Scaled from 1 to 5 servings; use your largest skillet or two.
ingredients: 1 lb 2 oz ground turkey (93% lean; about 17 1/2 oz)
steps: Dice the sweet potato into 1/2-inch cubes and finely chop the onion.
Heat the avocado oil in a large non-stick skillet (or two) over medium-high heat.
Add the sweet potato and onion and sauté until the potatoes are tender and golden.
Push the vegetables aside, add the turkey and garlic powder, and break it up until browned and cooked through.
Add the spinach and stir until just wilted.
Lower heat to medium, pour in the whisked eggs, and gently scramble everything until the eggs are set.

title: Potato Hash & Eggs
description: Crispy spiced potato hash with onion and spinach, topped with eggs steamed right in the pan. Breakfast-for-dinner. Scaled from 1 to 5 servings; cook in 2 large skillets or batches.
ingredients: 1.5 kg white potatoes (about 3 1/4 lb), diced 1 cm
20 g ground spices: cumin, paprika and turmeric (about 2 1/2 tbsp total)
steps: Dice the potatoes at 1 cm. Bigger pieces won't cook through before the outsides burn.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning every few minutes so they crust rather than steam (use 2 large skillets for this amount).
Add the onion and spices for the last 5 minutes, and the spinach for the last 1.
Push everything aside, crack the eggs into the space, and cover the pan 2 minutes until the eggs are set.

title: Tomato Spinach Shrimp Pasta
description: Garlicky shrimp tossed with pasta, cherry tomatoes and spinach in a light broth sauce. Scaled from 4 to 5 servings. Red pepper flakes are optional; leave them out so it's mild for the kids.
ingredients: 10 oz spaghetti or your preferred pasta
1 1/4 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional; skip for kids)
2/3 cup low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth (clean, no additives)
1/3 cup grated Parmesan cheese (optional, for serving)
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta per the package, usually 8-10 minutes. Drain, reserving about 1/2 cup pasta water.
In a large skillet, heat half the olive oil over medium heat. Add the shrimp, season with salt and pepper, and cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Remove and set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the skillet and sauté the garlic (and red pepper flakes, if using) 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and cook 3-4 minutes until they soften.
Add the spinach and let it wilt. Pour in the broth, scrape up any bits, and simmer 2 minutes.
Add the pasta and toss to coat, adding a little pasta water if needed.
Return the shrimp and toss until heated through.
Serve topped with Parmesan and basil, if desired.

title: Ground Turkey Sweet Potato Skillet
description: Taco-spiced turkey and sweet potato skillet topped with melted cheddar; serve over romaine as taco bowls. Uses the page's homemade taco seasoning instead of a packet. Makes 5 servings as written.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

Homemade taco seasoning: 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (optional; skip for kids)
Romaine lettuce, finely chopped, for serving
Optional toppings: Greek yogurt, salsa, guacamole or mashed avocado
steps: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add 1/2 tbsp olive oil. Add the turkey and cook, stirring often, until no longer pink.

Move the turkey to a plate. Heat the remaining 1/2 tbsp oil in the same skillet, add the onion and sweet potato, and season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook over low-medium heat until the sweet potatoes are soft, 10-15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Return the turkey to the skillet with the homemade taco seasoning. Stir well, adding about 2 tbsp water so the seasoning coats everything.
Top with cheese and cover until melted, or broil about 5 minutes until bubbly. Serve over romaine with Greek yogurt, salsa and guacamole if you like.

title: Spicy Ground Beef and Sweet Potato Skillet
description: One-skillet lean beef with sweet potatoes, tomatoes and corn. Scaled from 4 to 5 servings. The cayenne is optional; leave it out so it's mild for the kids.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional; skip for kids)
2 cups sweet potato (scant), peeled and diced into 1/2-inch cubes
About 19 oz diced tomatoes with juice (one 15-oz can plus 1/2 cup)
2/3 cup low-sodium beef broth (clean, no additives)
Salt and black pepper to taste
Optional toppings: chopped cilantro, avocado, lime wedges
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Drain excess grease. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin, cayenne (if using) and smoked paprika; cook 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, diced tomatoes with their juice, and broth. Stir well and season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook 15-20 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are fork-tender. Stir occasionally.
Stir in the corn and cook 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot with optional cilantro, avocado and lime.

title: Sheet Pan Honey-Soy Salmon, Sweet Potatoes, and Green Beans
description: Honey-soy-lime glazed salmon roasted with sweet potatoes and garlicky green beans. Scaled from 4 to 5 servings; use two pans if crowded.
ingredients: Cooking spray (or a little avocado oil)
2 Tbsp lower-sodium soy sauce or tamari (scant)
1 1/4 lb sweet potatoes, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line an 18 x 13-inch rimmed baking sheet (or two) with foil; coat with cooking spray.
Whisk the soy sauce, 1 1/4 Tbsp of the oil, the honey, lime juice and half the garlic in a large bowl. Add the salmon and toss to coat.
Put the sweet potatoes on the pan. Drizzle with 1 1/4 Tbsp oil and sprinkle with half the salt and pepper; toss. Roast until almost fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
A few minutes before the potatoes are done, toss the green beans with the remaining oil and garlic, and the rest of the salt and pepper.
Stir the potatoes and push them to one end of the pan. Place the salmon in the center and spread the green beans over the open space. Roast 15 minutes.

title: Sheet Pan Baked Salmon with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Salmon brushed with a lemon-Dijon herb sauce, roasted on one pan with potatoes and green beans. Scaled from 4 to 5 servings.
ingredients: 20 oz potatoes with skin (new or baby potatoes work best)
3 3/4 tablespoons lemon juice (use less for a milder sauce)
25 oz wild coho salmon, cut into five 5-oz portions
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Dice the potatoes (peel if you like). Toss with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Spread on a large baking sheet and bake 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine lemon juice, Dijon, parsley and dill in a small bowl. For a milder sauce, use only 2-3 teaspoons lemon juice.
Remove the pan and move the potatoes to one side.
Place the salmon fillets skin side down on the other side and brush with the lemon mixture. Add the green beans around the salmon.
Return to the oven for 10-15 minutes, until the salmon flakes with a fork.
Garnish with extra chopped dill and parsley, if desired.

title: 5-Ingredient Instant Pot Cheesy Chicken, Broccoli and Rice
description: Cheesy, homemade take on the boxed classic, made in a 6-quart Instant Pot. Scaled from 4 to 5 servings (keep the broth-to-rice ratio; same cook time).
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups + 2 tbsp low-sodium chicken broth (any clean broth instead of the brand named)
25 oz boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in 1-inch pieces
1 1/4 cups shredded sharp Cheddar cheese (5 oz)
steps: Spray a 6-quart Instant Pot insert with cooking spray (or wipe with oil). Mix broth, rice, salt and pepper in the insert.
Stir in chicken and broccoli. Secure lid; set pressure valve to SEALING. Select MANUAL; cook on high pressure 10 minutes. Select CANCEL. Set valve to VENTING to quick-release pressure.
Stir in cheese. Broccoli will break down when stirring.

title: 5 Ingredient Chicken and Broccoli with Rice
description: One-pot weeknight dinner: browned chicken thighs, rice and broccoli simmered in broth and soy sauce. Scaled from 4 to 5 servings.

macros._note: Calories, protein and fat from the recipe page; carbs estimated (page doesn't list them).

ingredients: 1 7/8 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs (about 30 oz), cut into bite-sized pieces
1 3/4 cups + 2 tbsp long-grain white rice, rinsed
3 cups + 2 tbsp low-sodium chicken broth (clean, no additives)
1/4 cup soy sauce (or tamari / coconut aminos)
steps: Heat a large pot or deep skillet with a tight-fitting lid over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook undisturbed 4-5 minutes until golden, then stir and brown 3-4 minutes more. It doesn't need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add the rinsed rice to the rendered fat and toast 1-2 minutes until slightly translucent and nutty. Stir in the soy sauce to coat the rice.
Return the chicken to the pot with the broccoli. Pour in the broth, stir, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 18-20 minutes until the rice absorbs most of the liquid.
Remove from heat and rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork; the chicken should reach 165°F. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken, Potatoes & Green Beans
description: One-pan lemon-herb chicken thighs roasted with baby potatoes and green beans. Scaled from 4 to 5 servings.

macros._note: Page states only ~38g protein (its own estimate); calories, carbs and fat estimated from ingredients with USDA values.

ingredients: 1 large lemon (zested and juiced) plus extra wedges for serving
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a large sheet pan with parchment (use two pans if crowded).
Whisk the olive oil, lemon zest and juice, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt and pepper.
Toss the potatoes with a third of the oil mixture, spread cut-side down on one half of the pan, and roast 15 minutes.
Coat the chicken in half of what remains, add skin-side up, and roast 20 minutes.
Toss the green beans in the last of the oil mixture, tuck around the chicken, and roast 12-15 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Squeeze lemon over, rest 5 minutes, and serve.

title: High Protein Hamburger Helper
description: One-pot weeknight dinner with extra veggies blended into the sauce with cottage cheese for a protein boost.
ingredients: 8 oz tomato sauce with basil, garlic & oregano (217 g)
1 medium carrot, cleaned and shredded (75 g)
1 medium zucchini, trimmed and shredded (180 g)
2 1/4 cups low sodium beef broth (18 fl oz)
1 cup fat free cottage cheese (8 fl oz)
1 cup skim ultra-filtered milk (8 fl oz)
1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese (90 g)
steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large, deep skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Once the oil is shimmery, add shredded zucchini and carrot, onion, and garlic and sauté until tender. Remove veggies to a bowl and add tomato sauce and cottage cheese, then blend with an immersion blender until smooth. This can also be done in a food processor or blender. Set aside.

Add remaining olive oil to skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Once shimmery, add ground beef and season with salt and pepper. Continue cooking, breaking apart until cooked through. Season with smoked paprika, oregano, ground mustard, and red pepper flakes.
Add the blended veggie and cottage cheese sauce, milk, and broth to the cooked ground beef. Stir until combined, then add pasta and stir until the noodles are covered with liquid.

Cover the skillet or pot and bring to a gentle boil for 8-11 minutes, or until the pasta is cooked very al dente, and remove from heat. The pasta will continue to cook in the sauce after being removed from the heat.
Stir in the cheese until melted, then serve.

title: High Protein Chicken Parmesan
description: Quick, healthy chicken parmesan packed with protein from cottage cheese. If you love Italian food, you're going to love this healthy dinner!
ingredients: Salt, garlic powder, onion powder + Italian herb blend
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.

Place tenderized chicken breasts on the baking sheet. Coat with olive oil, then season both sides generously with salt, onion powder, garlic powder and Italian herb blend. Bake 15 minutes or until the chicken's internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove from oven and top each piece with marinara, then 3 tbsp cottage cheese, then lots of grated parmesan. Return to the oven for 5–7 minutes.
